items.description: Ben Stokes registered for the IPL 2027 mini-auction, having missed the previous mega-auction. Harry Brook, however, is banned from the IPL until 2028 following his withdrawal after being picked by Delhi Capitals. The BCCI's regulations impose stricter penalties for players who withdraw after the auction. These measures aim to protect franchises from losing contracted players unexpectedly.
